    # Copy the regression configuration in a special folder, so all autogenerated
    # folders end up in the same place after running regression.
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/regression.cfg
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/regression.cfg
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/regression.cfg
            MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/regression.cfg
            COMMENT "Copying regression.cfg regression file"
    )

    # Create a new target which copies all regression files
    # Subdirectory targets will add themselves as dependencies
    add_custom_target(regression_files
            ALL  # this is needed because 'make test' doesn't resolve dependencies, and otherwise this is never executed
            DEPENDS
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/regression/regression.cfg
    )

    # Create a new target which runs the regression
    # Subdirectory targets will add themselves as dependencies
    add_custom_target(regression)

    add_subdirectory(regression)
    add_subdirectory(stationlist)

    # ---- E2E Lifecycle Tests ----
    # These tests verify the game doesn't crash during common operations:
    # new game generation, savegame loading, different landscapes/sizes.
    # Each test runs headlessly with -vnull and checks for crash logs.
    # The GfxFillRect variant crash (genworld_gui.cpp preview) was caught
    # this way after being missed by unit tests.

    # Copy lifecycle config files to build directory
    set(LIFECYCLE_CFGS
        lifecycle lifecycle_temperate lifecycle_arctic lifecycle_tropic lifecycle_toyland
        lifecycle_large lifecycle_arctic_large lifecycle_tropic_large
        lifecycle_many_rivers lifecycle_flat lifecycle_many_towns lifecycle_long_run
        lifecycle_shape_island lifecycle_shape_archipelago lifecycle_shape_fjords
        lifecycle_shape_scattered lifecycle_shape_peninsula lifecycle_shape_mesa
        lifecycle_shape_volcanic lifecycle_improved_perlin
        lifecycle_biome_arctic lifecycle_biome_tropic
        lifecycle_tiny lifecycle_asymmetric
        lifecycle_lakes_mountains
    )
    foreach(CFG ${LIFECYCLE_CFGS})
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
                        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                COMMENT "Copying ${CFG}.cfg"
        )
        list(APPEND LIFECYCLE_CFG_FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg)
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(lifecycle_cfg ALL DEPENDS ${LIFECYCLE_CFG_FILES})

    # Helper macro to add a lifecycle test (100 ticks default).
    macro(add_lifecycle_test TEST_NAME)
        add_lifecycle_test_ticks(${TEST_NAME} 100 ${ARGN})
    endmacro()

    # Helper macro with custom tick count.
    macro(add_lifecycle_test_ticks TEST_NAME TICKS)
        add_test(NAME lifecycle_${TEST_NAME}
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                        -DOPENTTD_EXECUTABLE=$<TARGET_FILE:openttd>
                        -DEDITBIN_EXECUTABLE=${EDITBIN_EXECUTABLE}
                        -DLIFECYCLE_TEST=${TEST_NAME}
                        -DLIFECYCLE_TICKS=${TICKS}
                        "-DOPENTTD_ARGS=${ARGN}"
                        -P "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/scripts/LifecycleTest.cmake"
                WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
        )
    endmacro()

    # New game generation - all 4 landscapes at 128x128 (fast)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_temperate -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_temperate.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_arctic    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_arctic.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_tropic    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_toyland   -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_toyland.cfg)

    # New game generation - 1024x1024 maps (stress test, all climates)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_large          -g -G 42 -c regression/lifecycle_large.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_arctic_large   -g -G 42 -c regression/lifecycle_arctic_large.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_tropic_large   -g -G 42 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_large.cfg)

    # Edge case: many rivers (exercises river/delta generation)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_many_rivers    -g -G 7  -c regression/lifecycle_many_rivers.cfg)

    # Edge case: flat map (exercises flat terrain code paths)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_flat           -g -G 1  -c regression/lifecycle_flat.cfg)

    # Edge case: high density towns + industries (exercises placement code)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_many_towns     -g -G 1  -c regression/lifecycle_many_towns.cfg)

    # Multiple different seeds (catches seed-dependent crashes)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_seed_0         -g -G 0  -c regression/lifecycle_temperate.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_seed_max       -g -G 4294967295 -c regression/lifecycle_temperate.cfg)

    # Long run: 1000 ticks to exercise game loop stability
    add_lifecycle_test_ticks(long_run_1000ticks 1000 -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_long_run.cfg)

    # Continent shapes (each exercises different mask algorithms in tgp.cpp)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_island       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_island.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_archipelago  -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_archipelago.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_fjords       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_fjords.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_scattered    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_scattered.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_peninsula    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_peninsula.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_mesa         -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_mesa.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_volcanic     -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_volcanic.cfg)

    # Terrain algorithm variant
    add_lifecycle_test(improved_perlin    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_improved_perlin.cfg)

    # Biome system (temperature-based snow/desert)
    add_lifecycle_test(biome_arctic       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_biome_arctic.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(biome_tropic       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_biome_tropic.cfg)

    # Map size edge cases
    add_lifecycle_test(tiny_64x64         -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tiny.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(asymmetric_512x64  -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_asymmetric.cfg)

    # Combined terrain features (lakes + mountains)
    add_lifecycle_test(lakes_mountains    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_lakes_mountains.cfg)

    # Load the existing regression test savegame (verifies save/load path)
    add_lifecycle_test(load_save -g ai/regression/test.sav -c regression/lifecycle.cfg)
